a clumsy attempt: He made a clumsy attempt to glue the broken vase, but he only broke it into more pieces.
他笨拙地嘗試把破花瓶黏好，結果只是把它弄得更碎。
clumsy wording: The clumsy wording of his letter made it confusing, although he only wanted to say thank you.
他信中笨拙的措辭讓人看得一頭霧水，雖然他只是想說聲謝謝。
a clumsy apology: He offered a clumsy apology, mumbling and looking at the floor, but she could tell he was sorry.
他笨拙地道了歉，含糊其辭又盯著地板，但她看得出他很抱歉。
coarse language: Coarse language is not allowed in class, so please stop swearing and choose polite words.
課堂上不准使用粗俗的語言，所以請停止罵髒話，選用有禮貌的字眼。
coarse sand: This beach is covered with coarse sand, so it hurts a little to walk on it with bare feet.
這片海灘覆蓋著粗沙，所以赤腳走在上面會有點痛。
a coarse sense of humor: He has a coarse sense of humor and often tells rude jokes that make others feel uncomfortable.
他的幽默感很粗俗，常講一些讓別人不舒服的低俗笑話。
coarse manners: His coarse manners, like eating loudly with his mouth open, embarrassed everyone at the wedding dinner.
他粗野的舉止，例如張著嘴大聲吃東西，讓婚宴上的每個人都很尷尬。
cognitive development: Reading stories to young children every night helps their cognitive development, including language and memory.
每晚念故事給幼童聽有助於他們的認知發展，包括語言和記憶。
cognitive skills: Puzzles and chess can improve cognitive skills such as memory, attention, and problem solving.
拼圖和西洋棋可以提升記憶力、專注力和解決問題等認知技能。
cognitive science: She majors in cognitive science because she wants to understand how the human brain learns and thinks.
她主修認知科學，因為她想了解人腦如何學習和思考。
a coherent argument: Her essay presented a coherent argument, with each point following logically from the one before.
她的文章提出了條理清晰的論點，每一點都合乎邏輯地承接上一點。
a coherent strategy: To reduce traffic, the city needs a coherent strategy in which buses, trains, and bike lanes work together.
為了減少交通流量，這座城市需要一套連貫一致的策略，讓公車、火車和自行車道相互配合。
be barely coherent: After working all night, the nurse was barely coherent and kept mixing up her words.
整夜工作後，那位護理師幾乎語無倫次，一直說錯話。
collective responsibility: The coach said that losing the game was a collective responsibility of the whole team, not one player's fault.
教練說輸掉比賽是全隊的集體責任，而不是某一個球員的錯。
a collective effort: Cleaning up the beach was a collective effort, with students, parents, and teachers all working together.
清理海灘是一次共同努力，學生、家長和老師全都一起合作。
collective memory: The terrible earthquake of 1999 is still part of Taiwan's collective memory, and many people remember it clearly.
1999年那場可怕的地震至今仍是台灣集體記憶的一部分，許多人都記得很清楚。
collective bargaining: Through collective bargaining, the workers' union asked the company for higher pay for all its members.
透過集體談判，工會為全體會員向公司爭取更高的薪資。
colonial rule: India was under British colonial rule for nearly two hundred years before it became independent in 1947.
印度在1947年獨立之前，受英國殖民統治將近兩百年。
the colonial era: During the colonial era, Taiwan was governed by Japan for fifty years, from 1895 to 1945.
在殖民時期，台灣從1895年到1945年受日本統治了五十年。
colonial architecture: Tainan has many buildings with colonial architecture, built when the Dutch and the Japanese ruled the island.
台南有許多殖民時期建築，是在荷蘭人和日本人統治這座島嶼時建造的。
a colorful character: My uncle is a colorful character who wears bright hats, tells wild stories, and makes everyone laugh.
我叔叔是個多采多姿的人物，戴著鮮豔的帽子、講離奇的故事，逗得大家哈哈笑。
a colorful past: The old sailor has a colorful past full of adventures; he was once a singer and even a circus clown.
那位老水手有段精彩的過去，充滿冒險；他曾經當過歌手，甚至當過馬戲團小丑。
colorful language: The angry taxi driver used some colorful language, full of swear words, when another car cut in front of him.
另一輛車插到前面時，那位生氣的計程車司機說了一些充滿髒話的粗俗生動的語言。
a compact car: We bought a compact car because it uses less gas and is easy to park on narrow city streets.
我們買了一輛小型車，因為它比較省油，而且在狹窄的市區街道上很好停車。
a compact design: This phone has a compact design, so it fits easily into a small pocket or purse.
這支手機有緊湊的設計，所以可以輕鬆放進小口袋或錢包裡。
a compact disc: Before music apps, people bought a compact disc to listen to their favorite singer's new album.
在音樂應用程式出現之前，人們會買光碟來聽自己喜愛歌手的新專輯。
be comparable to: The food at this small family restaurant is comparable to the food at many expensive hotels.
這間家庭小餐館的食物可與許多昂貴飯店的食物相比。
of comparable size: The two schools are of comparable size, each with about two thousand students and a hundred teachers.
這兩所學校大小相當，各約有兩千名學生和一百位老師。
comparable figures: To compare the two cities fairly, we need comparable figures collected in the same year and in the same way.
為了公平比較這兩座城市，我們需要在同一年、用同樣方式收集的可比較的數據。
